title: Create task creation form
userStory: As a developer, I want to create new Ralph tasks with full context so that they have everything needed for planning and execution.
acceptanceCriteria: New Task button opens creation modal/drawer
Form fields: title, workspace (dropdown), prompt/instructions (textarea), file paths (multi-input), constraints (textarea), expected outcomes (textarea)
Git section: base branch (dropdown from workspace branches), feature branch name (auto-suggested), PR target branch
Save creates task in Draft status
Validation prevents empty required fields (title, workspace, prompt)
